title: US jury finds Huawei guilty in trade secrets and fraud case
seoTitle: Huawei US verdict: what the jury found and what happens next
dek: A Brooklyn jury convicted Huawei on 10 counts, including conspiring to steal trade secrets. Huawei was acquitted of racketeering conspiracy and says it will appeal.
happened: A federal jury in Brooklyn found Huawei guilty on 10 of 12 counts on November 24. The convictions covered trade secret theft conspiracy, fraud and sanctions violations. Jurors acquitted the company of racketeering conspiracy and conspiracy to obstruct justice.

sides.says: The Justice Department said Huawei took proprietary technology and misled banks to conceal dealings with sanctioned entities in Iran.
The company disputed the legal basis of the convictions. Its lawyer said Huawei would appeal and pointed to the acquittals as a rejection of parts of the prosecution’s account.

next: The Justice Department says sentencing is set for September 14, 2027. The defendants face possible fines, forfeiture and restitution. Huawei’s lawyer says the company will appeal.
summary: A US jury found Huawei guilty on 10 counts and acquitted it on two. Sentencing is scheduled for September 2027, and Huawei says it will appeal.
